description: This file appears to be a shell script that sets up and runs integration tests related to a Git SVN repository, specifically testing behavior with deleted and re-added directories.

methods.name: require_svnserve
methods.description: Ensures that an SVN server port is available before proceeding with tests.

methods.name: svnadmin load
methods.description: Loads a repository dump into an SVN repository.

methods.name: git svn init
methods.description: Initializes a git-svn repository linked to the specified SVN URL.

methods.name: git svn fetch
methods.description: Fetches latest changes from SVN into the git repository.
